name: Facet
text: We should focus on shipping a live HTML/CSS prototype tonight, integrating real API calls to enhance performance visualization. This approach ensures immediate interactivity and responsiveness, allowing users to experience genuine data insights in real-time. The trade-off here is that we might sacrifice some polish in styling for functionality, but the benefits of engagement and clarity will outweigh this compromise.

name: Pane
text: Shipping a live prototype tonight with real API calls risks exposing fragile design assumptions under real load—what if the API throttles or returns malformed data? A safer alternative is shipping a static mock prototype first, then layering in real API calls only after the visualization’s core behavior is proven stable. Settle it by defining a clear threshold: if the mock prototype meets the "visibility, liveliness, clarity" criteria in a 15-minute user test, we proceed to real calls; if not, we iterate on the mock.
